newsitem.title: USA: Uniroyal Technology halts deal to sell unit.
newsitem.headline: Uniroyal Technology halts deal to sell unit.

text.p: Uniroyal Technology Corp said on Monday that it terminated its agreement to sell its Polycast Technology division.
The agreement had been with an affiliate with Cortec Group Fund II LP for undisclosed terms.
The company did not say why the deal was terminated or if there would be efforts to revive it in the future.
Polycast manufactures cell cast acrylic products. Uniroyal manufactures and sells plastic and chemical products.
Cortec is a buyout group specializing in middle market manufactured product companies.
